labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: New behaviour requested for ReprHighlighter; feature requests are approved in Discussions first.

items.body:
This is a feature request for a new `ReprHighlighter` behaviour. Per the feature template, new features need to be approved in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so please start there.

Rich already lets you style units without changing `ReprHighlighter`: subclass `RegexHighlighter` with your own pattern, as shown in [the highlighting docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst).

Related: #3318 (number highlight regex).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
